```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,features = c(
    "Elane",    # promyelocyte
    "Prtn3",    # promyelocyte
    "Ctsg",     # promyelocyte
    "Itgam",    # myelocyte+ (CD11b)
    "Csf3r",    # mature neutrophil (G-CSFR)
    "Fcgr3",    # mature neutrophil (CD16)
    "Cxcr2",
    "Prtn3"
),reduction = "umap.nn",split.by = "sample.name",pt.size = 0.1, order = T)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()
```
